review.root: Reviewed full fixed capture publication and typed attachment, raw/full custody cycle prevention, exact original seal and known S+C origin checks, fourteen neutral failure/reuse tests and native fixture updates. Reviewed all native fixed capacity/sink production and eleven tests, binding identity, fixed prefix survival, measured control/handle sizes and explicit unactivated scope. Reviewed cold linked C++ sizeof implementation, raw binding and real runtime-lock/housekeeping test. No new native span gateway or complete enclosing inventory is claimed. Reviewed all terminal-trim production changes, thirteen new neutral tests, actual native original-admission probe/fixture corrections and documentation. Scope classification and terminal host balance retain original capacity; every recovered poisoned cleanup path quarantines before trim/refill. Exact aliases, host transfer, zero-byte origins and both close orders remain covered. Independent review found and author fixed the poison-order defect before this frozen package. Accepted independent combined review of actual nested sizes, typed C publication and host trim, native inspection-handle cost, poison retirement ordering and test-only accepted-funding probe. Its one concrete stale-fixture finding is addressed by the separately reviewed exact controls overlay before validation. Read complete three native controls ownership cases and exact immutable overlay: healthy run/native closure trims the source-only tail to original protected controls plus registered C, and final source retirement remains exact zero. No production or assertion weakening. Compiler validation found three sibling-module accesses to private funding.pool; replaced them with the existing borrowed pool() accessor, preserving the same identity, clones and lock order without changing visibility or representation. Runtime validation passed 1,159 tests and exposed three old terminal expectations. Corrected exact frame tail to H+native backing, zero-host tail to zero bytes while asserting its unquoted exclusion survives until saved-owner drop, and poisoned cleanup to retained original 128-byte quarantined account with all run/metadata/scopes closed. No production accounting, failure types, numerical output or initial budget assertions changed. Native compilation required the actual immutable-weight ResidencyManager import (distinct from CacheResidencyManager) and Debug on the no-operations test mechanism to satisfy its existing trait bound. No behavior or ownership changes. Reviewed two frozen native fixture corrections fully: exact physical allocation multiset versus independent loaded parameters plus actual manager array, reserved optional-slot ceilings unchanged, and real runtime-lock Busy handshake. Completed capture tails retain exact H or H plus measured native alias bytes after existing explicit settlement/certification; failure/quarantine expectations unchanged. Saved sampling closes WorkspaceCopyCustody only after its work scope was already certified, so array-first retirement now requires exactly sampler H plus separately registered native aliases, preserving both close orders and final zero. Added actual-error diagnostic to the remaining admission failure without changing its expected error. The last native admission failure was the existing typed ExecutionFenced: actual session handoffs are retained automatically, and CapacityHandoffPlan rejects raising a predecessor ceiling while original host-held remainder survives. Strengthened the test to assert BudgetExceeded at the original ceiling, ExecutionFenced at the proposed larger ceiling, exact unchanged effective capacity, and unchanged cold native/controller state on all three routes. No production behavior changed. Central execution showed ResidentUnitWindow correctly lacks mutable resident parameter visitation. The independent physical oracle now visits actual static/model-unit parameters during construction, explicitly evaluates them, then moves those same owners into the unchanged resident window. All exact allocation multisets, six categories, original optional maxima and admission assertions remain unchanged. The prior Busy correction passed. Native fixed collection now verifies both actual allocation multisets. Its last old zero expectation overlooked a live foreign-control diagnostic: PreparedTextControlWorkspace owns an alias of the actual original equation plan, whose later custody is shared even when control binding differs. The test now asserts exact held bytes before and after capsule drop, then zero after dropping that diagnostic. No owner or lifetime is discounted.

A private native/host scope purpose and checked native count preserve original held balances, source pins, zero-byte origins and capacity ceilings; recovered poisoned cleanup quarantines before any trimming or refill.
